Add the tomato and water.
Cook for 15 minutes, then add the eggplant.
Adding the eggplant last keeps it from falling apart.
Tomato rice pilaf
Cook the tomato paste and tomatoes in butter.
Add the rice and toast it.
Let it rest.
Tomato adds a slight tang to the pilaf.
Brown rice pilaf with vegetables
Soak the brown rice for 1 hour.
Sauté the vegetables in oil for 4 minutes.
Cook with the water and salt for 35 minutes.
Brown rice is rich in fibre.
Chestnut pilaf
200 g boiled chestnuts
1 dessert spoon salt, cinnamon
Toast the rice in butter.
Add the coarsely chopped chestnuts.
Let rest with cinnamon for 15 minutes.
Goes well with turkey or chicken.
Bulgur, lentil and couscous pilaf
Half a cup couscous
Add the bulgur and couscous and toast.
Cook with the lentils, water and salt for 12 minutes.
Couscous adds a different texture to the pilaf.
Saffron pilaf with nuts
2 cups basmati rice
2 tablespoons almonds
1 pinch saffron or 1 teaspoon turmeric
Steep the saffron in hot water.
Toast the almonds in butter.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Cook with the saffron water, currants and salt for 15 minutes.
Turmeric is an economical alternative to saffron.
Zucchini bulgur pilaf (fluffy)
1 dessert spoon salt, mint
Add the diced zucchini and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the bulgur and water.
Let rest with mint.
Cut the zucchini coarsely so it doesn’t fall apart.
Plain buttered rice pilaf
2 cups baldo rice
3 cups hot chicken stock or water
Soak the rice in hot salted water for 20 minutes, then wash until the starch runs clear.
Toast the rice in butter for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the hot water and salt.
Cook over low heat for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Rest for 20 minutes with a paper towel.
Use 1.5 times as much water as rice.
Türlü (mixed vegetable stew)
200 g green beans
Cut all the vegetables into large cubes.
Add the firm vegetables (potato, beans) first.
Add the other vegetables and 1 glass of water.
Cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
It can also be cooked in a casserole in the oven.
Spinach with eggs
1 kg spinach
Add the chopped spinach and the rice.
Crack in the eggs and cover.
Spinach releases its own liquid; don’t add water.
Celeriac with carrots in olive oil
2 celeriac roots
Dice the celeriac and keep in lemon water.
Add the carrot, potato and celeriac.
Cook with 1.5 glasses of water, lemon, sugar and salt for 30 minutes.
Leave to cool with dill.
Lemon water preserves the celeriac’s colour.
Baked cauliflower fritters (mücver)
Half a cauliflower (boiled)
Mash the cauliflower.
Add the other ingredients and mix.
Drain the cauliflower thoroughly.
Zucchini sinkonta (Bodrum style)
Cut the zucchini into large pieces without peeling.
Add the zucchini and grated tomato.
Cook covered for 25 minutes.
Zucchini cooks in its own juices; don’t add water.
Meatless eggplant oturtma
Slice the eggplants into rounds and roast in the oven.
Make a sauce with the onion, garlic, pepper and tomato.
Arrange the eggplants in a dish and pour over the sauce.
A vegetarian main course.
Mushroom and pepper sauté
500 g mushrooms
1 teaspoon salt, thyme, black pepper
Slice the mushrooms.
Fry the onion and pepper in butter.
Add the mushrooms and cook over high heat until their liquid evaporates.
Add the spices.
Add the salt last so the mushrooms don’t release water.
Baked vegetable gratin
Béchamel: 2 tablespoons butter, 2 tablespoons flour, 2 cups milk
1 teaspoon salt, nutmeg
Blanch the vegetables for 5 minutes.
Make the béchamel sauce.
Arrange the vegetables in a baking dish and pour over the sauce.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Don’t overboil the vegetables.
Okra with lemon in olive oil
500 g okra
Trim the okra tops and soak in lemon water for 30 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and okra.
Cook with 1 glass of water, lemon, salt and sugar for 30 minutes.
Stir as little as possible so the okra doesn’t turn slimy.
Leeks in olive oil (with carrot and rice)
Cut the leeks into 2 cm rings and the carrot into slices.
Sauté in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice, lemon, sugar, salt and 1 glass of water.
Wash well between the leek layers.
Baked stuffed zucchini (meatless)
Make a filling with the onion, rice, tomato and spices.
Arrange in a baking dish and add 1 glass of water.
Bake at 190 °C for 40 minutes.
You can add the scooped-out zucchini flesh to the filling.
Fried peppers with roasted eggplant
Char and peel the eggplants and chop coarsely.
Fry the peppers in oil.
Add the garlic and tomato.
